jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Granville-Hancock Unified District, a unified union district in the White River Valley Supervisory Union (member towns Granville and Hancock). Non-operating (tuitions all students).
White River Valley Supervisory Union (official site).

sources.note: Granville-Hancock Unified District 2026 Annual Meeting Warning (the district's own document, White River Valley SU site): the district elects at its May annual meeting -- Granville 1 director for a 3-year term, Hancock 1 for a 3-year term, Granville 1 for two years (remainder of a 3-year term). The board is six directors, three per town, elected by town-only electorates (the section 730(a)(1) pattern; AOE State Board Item Q-3, 2017: members 'elected by the voters of each town... allocated at three members each').

Granville-Hancock board page and approved minutes (White River Valley SU, official): May 18, 2026 reorganization seats Peters (Chair), Sheehan (Vice Chair), Deering (Clerk) and Neale; Anderson seated and voting June 16, 2026; August 25, 2026 minutes appoint Rachel Alberico to the vacant Granville seat. Term expirations are from the 2026 warning's signature block and the Town of Granville officials page (Peters 2027, Neale 2027, Deering 2028, Sheehan 2029). Which Granville seat Anderson won on May 12, 2026 (the 3-year seat vs. the 2-year remainder) is not stated in any fetched minutes -- the missing document is the May 12, 2026 annual meeting minutes -- so Anderson and Alberico carry no term end.
